recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If the exact accepted short/definition wording still matters, PHWG or the immunization-incubator maintainers should update the relocated ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.description definition in that external IG; no core follow-up is needed unless these resources return to the core build.
issue_request: FHIR-39576 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested markdown rather than string for ImmunizationEvaluation.description and ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.description, and also accepted revised ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.description short/definition text of 'Recommendation notes.' and 'Contains additional information about the recommendation.'.
initial_application: Core commit 1cd64a9e38375394799cf32aad59044410833f2f changed both requested .description type codes from string to markdown. R5 published profiles confirm the markdown datatype for both elements, though the secondary recommendation.description short/definition wording remained the older protocol wording.
additional_context: FHIR-38714 supplied the broader markdown compatibility guidance that prompted this review family, and PHWG 2023-01-17 minutes confirm the FHIR-39576 motion and vote. Later core commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation source/config entries from the current core build and changed core narrative/history references toward the HL7 immunization-incubator IG. Current core only retains non-authoritative compatibility/narrative/stale-warning references to these names.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR-core source was changed because the current build has no active core StructureDefinition source for the affected elements; editing stale maintenance references would not change implementer-facing conformance.

related_jiras.note: Published markdown datatype guidance stated that converting optional string elements to markdown is compatible and led to the review that produced FHIR-39576.
Separate Immunization.reason example value set correction shared the initial application commit but was not part of this reconciliation decision.
